term: causal power as capacity or disposition
definition: A bearer can bring about an effect under suitable conditions, whether or not it is currently producing an effect. Possessing such a capacity alone does not assert any present exercise, causal transmission, or sufficient ground for the capacity's own existence.
note: An alternative sense retained for the #319 disambiguation, not an attributed source reading or a new Lean predicate. The current Profile models a designated actually transmitted power, not every ability or metaphysical potency. An adequate capacity semantics would need further conditions, activation and time/respect parameters.
